criteria: Locked datasets/mission3_before_after_labels_v1.json; core_pass means required business meaning/status represented and no spurious committed decision/action; full_pass also requires no demonstrably false warnings/audit and sufficient supporting evidence. M3-only utility labels are not retroactively counted against M2 core.

cases.evidence_review: Customer requirement supported by L001 but later explicit reaffirmation L005 was not cited; action cancellation source L004 present.
cases.audit_review: One false positive: auditor demands cancellation reason 'giấy phép không phù hợp' as an active condition of cancelled task. Cancellation reason is not a precondition for implementation.
cases.lesson: Retain business requirement independently; reduce audit false positives and improve late-source evidence coverage.

cases.evidence_review: L001 supports assignment to Lan; L003 supports cancelled status, no due invented.
cases.audit_review: No audit findings; transcript's straightforward cancellation has supporting evidence.
cases.lesson: M2 already solves basic cancellation; do not use this single case as proof of an M3 improvement.

cases.evidence_review: L003 supports agreed B pilot, L004 blocked legal approval, L005 open vendor choice.
cases.audit_review: Auditor has no findings, but deterministic verifier incorrectly flags unrelated L005 'chưa chốt nhà cung cấp' as late negation of already agreed architecture/pilot decision.
cases.lesson: Scope later negation to the same decision issue to avoid cross-topic verifier false warnings.

cases.evidence_review: L001 task correct; L002 technical practice present but marked meeting_status unverified instead of locked recorded knowledge-candidate; L003 unverified performance rumor conservatively flagged; L004 no-choice wrongly represented as proposed, not open.
cases.audit_review: No audit findings despite wrong unresolved-vs-proposed representation. Utility class current_work/reusable_candidate/needs_verification does not yet exist in M2.
cases.lesson: M3 needs explicit information utility labels and unresolved choice extraction, without asserting a rumored performance claim.

limitations: 4 synthetic development cases, assistant-authored gold/review, no independent benchmark
Hosted backend reports model but not exact source commit, so source byte identity cannot be proven
One fresh run per case, temperature is not guaranteed deterministic
Required semantic core pass and full pass are operational judgments, not statistical model accuracy
Existing eight-case historical baseline is a separate run; do not merge denominators
